result.summary: Wrote lit.md for seed 808 / round 3, answering the four literature questions in analysis.md §5 (day_centroid(Amt) time-of-day slow component + closing-auction/institutional-risk identity; grouping-variable choice in conditional sorts; day_autocorr_n1(Ret) as Roll-style microstructure noise; why order-dependent minute statistics beat order-invariant concentration ratios). Checked r1/r2 lit.md first to avoid citing sources already used in rounds 1-2. Found and verified 14 new pre-2023-08-08 sources (Bogousslavsky 2016 JF; Qiu/Huang/Jiang 2023 FRL; Lou/Polk/Skouras 2019 JFE; BlackRock 2020 whitepaper; Han/Zhao/Chen/Guo 2022 PBFJ on the 2018 SSE closing-auction reform; Freyberger/Neuhierl/Weber NBER WP23227->RFS 2020; Bessembinder/Cooper/Zhang 2019 RFS; Roll 1984 JF; Asparouhova/Bessembinder/Kalcheva 2010 JFE; Subrahmanyam 2008 QREF; Qiu 2022 PhD thesis; Eom/Choi/Oh/Jung 2007 arXiv->2008 Physica A; Stachowiak 2004 Economie et Prevision; Hasbrouck 1991 JF), each with full citation + verified:true, and for each question extracted concrete operator-translatable processing recipes while honestly logging items that could not be found (several "no result, not fabricated" notes per question, one unverifiable dissertation excluded from the reference table).
